description: SQDC supplier requirements plus Quebec product restrictions. Quebec is the strictest jurisdiction; a product that passes this profile is not necessarily allowed elsewhere, and vice versa.

sources.title: SQDC Guide de création d'un nouveau produit (August 2024)

notes: The SQDC requires AI (90) quantity-per-case on case labels; the OCS forbids AI (90). A product sold in both needs different case labels.
Full COA for the first lot before the first shipment; later COAs on request.
Cultivé Québec identifier requires at least 65% Quebec-grown input; record it in jurisdictions[].cultiveQuebec.
French must be at least as prominent as any other language on the label; French product names are preferred.
Ready-to-drink beverages in aluminium cans need an additional UPC-A for the deposit program.
